missing_bindings.name: Traversal checkpoint and comparison handoff
missing_bindings.reason: A typed target checkpoint for visited/frontier identities, read mode, attempts and remaining budget is absent. CapabilityResult.continuation_state is a raw object and does not define these keys.

branches.label: Continue through observed candidates
branches.condition: Jev selected an unvisited useful frontier and budget remains
branches.description: The kernel goes back to choosing the next navigation step with the observed candidates, visit history and remaining budget, without starting over.

missing_bindings.name: Continue with observed frontier
missing_bindings.reason: The no-replay continuation requires the actual observed frontier and visited history; no binding exists.

branches.label: Switch or add a method
branches.condition: Jev selected an alternative/complementary method after limited progress
branches.description: The kernel sends the outcomes to the shared comparison and back to method selection, keeping useful evidence so the next plan can use another method or both.

missing_bindings.name: Return traversal attempts for replanning
missing_bindings.reason: The shared comparison/method plan continuation is undefined, so useful retained evidence cannot yet be handed off through a typed target aggregate.

branches.label: No permitted next read
branches.condition: No useful unvisited candidate remains, the budget is exhausted, or the selected read is refused
branches.description: The kernel skips reading, records the outcome for the shared comparison and finishes as partial or blocked when no other useful method remains, without retrying the same read.

missing_bindings.name: Exhausted traversal outcome
missing_bindings.reason: The target must distinguish read/time/depth/scan exhaustion from no matches; no combined traversal outcome binding exists.

branches.label: Clarify intent or authority
branches.condition: Observed evidence exposes a material ambiguity that cannot be resolved safely
branches.description: Jev chooses to ask a clarifying question, which is retained with the evidence and history and passes through the shared comparison before the question is sent.

missing_bindings.name: Traversal clarification decision
missing_bindings.reason: The specific missing fact plus retained frontier/history must reach the main loop; no target decision-context binding exists.

branches.label: Retain a decision without reading
branches.condition: Jev chose return, switch, clarification or stop instead of a read
branches.description: The kernel skips reading and judging and goes straight to retention, keeping the existing attempts, evidence, open candidates and budget.

missing_bindings.name: Validated non-reading continuation
missing_bindings.reason: A selected return/switch/clarify/stop must preserve state without reading; the target validated non-reading record is undefined.

provenance.note:
Proposed adaptive traversal — not built
This dedicated method refines the existing retrieval journey. It describes Jev frontier choice and System traversal with multi-method return routes. Existing bounded graph operations and native repository retrieval are reusable primitives, not proof that this adaptive node/folder navigation loop is wired. No runtime, provider or source publication occurs in this design task.

Architecture evidence: existing graph neighbour/recipe operations and native allowlisted file enumeration/locators are primitives. No public Jev frontier-navigation or directory-listing contract is currently exposed. A proposed typed enumerate-frontier/read-selected adapter must preserve visited IDs and scan bounds. Native worktree reads are not immutable Git reads merely because a revision label is attached. This draft does not claim a complete code/call/import graph.

Added source-bound field/type/requiredness/default metadata and explicitly illustrative JSON projections. Preserved topology, actor ownership, realization and AC status. Non-JSON artifacts and genuinely undefined proposed interfaces remain explicit.

acceptance_scenarios.given: Jev selected an unvisited useful frontier and budget remains
acceptance_scenarios.then: Return to [frontier selection](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#frontier) with the actual observed candidates, visited history and cumulative budget; do not recreate the starting state.

acceptance_scenarios.given: Jev selected an alternative/complementary method after limited progress
acceptance_scenarios.then: Return outcomes to [comparison and advisory recording](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare), then [method selection](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#plan). Preserve useful evidence; the next plan may use another method or both compatible methods.

acceptance_scenarios.given: No useful unvisited candidate remains, the budget is exhausted, or the selected read is refused
acceptance_scenarios.then: Skip reading and retain an explicit bounded outcome. Join [shared comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare); if no other permitted useful method remains, finish partial/blocked without an identical retry.

acceptance_scenarios.given: Observed evidence exposes a material ambiguity that cannot be resolved safely
acceptance_scenarios.then: Choose the bounded clarification outcome without authoring question prose. Pass this decision to [System retention](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#retain), then [shared attempt comparison](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieve-project-knowledge.flow.json#compare) and advisory recording before main clarification dispatch. Preserve evidence and history; do not invent the missing fact.

acceptance_scenarios.given: Jev chose return, switch, clarification or stop instead of a read
acceptance_scenarios.then: Validate the bounded non-reading action and route directly to [System retention](docs/product-truth/flows/leafcutter/retrieval-source-traversal.flow.json#retain). Skip both read and post-read judgment; retain the existing attempts, evidence, frontier and budget. Only an accepted read selection reaches the read step.
